# B"H — 02 — Heichel Repair Plan (incl. listing layer + palace metaphor)

## 0. Phase 0 first: fix the boot chain (gating)

1. READ `critical-boot.js`, `ikar-stable.js`, `ikar-first.js` in full before
   touching anything. Trace every consumer of their exports.
2. Restore the contract: `bootIkarFirst` is a function, reachable through the
   chain, `semantic` present in the document before first-light paint.
3. Rewrite complete files (no surgical patches that leave the chain
   inconsistent), tabs, no minify, ~120-line modules, read-after-write.
4. Restart `node index` (no watcher) and verify `/heichelos/ikar` paints
   `#heichel-boot-title` + discovery list from the semantic model.
5. NOTHING in sections below starts until the root renders. This is the gate.

## 1. Root hydration (grand hall)

- Heichel root renders EXCLUSIVELY from `GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar`.
  Title "The Entire Torah" comes from the payload — never a literal.
- No description field exists → the root shows an elegant quiet where a
  description would sit, or real data (counts, recency) if the API provides it.
  Never fabricated copy.

## 2. The palace metaphor — FIRST-CLASS design principle for Heichel

"Heichelos" literally means palaces. The UI must feel like walking through one —
but better.

- ARRIVAL: entering a Heichel feels like stepping through grand doors. The
  identity hero lands with WEIGHT (DB-backed title, presence, scale) and then
  OPENS into the space. Never a dashboard that just appears.
- ARCHITECTURE: halls → chambers → scrolls. Grand hall = Heichel root.
  Chambers = series / sub-series. Scrolls = posts. Information hierarchy reads
  as palace architecture; route transitions feel like moving through rooms —
  forward motion INTO spaces, graceful return, route continuity preserved.
- DEPTH AND LIGHT: the futuristic material language (deep midnight, cyan
  intelligence, gold warmth, glass) creates palatial depth — layered surfaces,
  light suggesting vastness, parallax conveying architecture. Grandeur through
  SPACE and LIGHT, never ornament spam.
- "BUT BETTER": a LIVING palace, not a museum. Alive with recent learning,
  community presence, continuing paths. Every chamber shows signs of life
  (recently updated, continue reading, activity) — or a truthful, elegant
  quiet when empty.
- PROCESSION: the core journey Heichel → series → post → lens → community
  feels like a guided procession — ONE obvious next step, momentum, no getting
  lost. Breadcrumbs are the thread back through the rooms.
- METAPHOR TEST (added to the embarrassment walk, 07): does this feel like
  processing through a palace, or clicking through an admin panel? If the
  latter — redesign, no matter how "correct" the code is.

## 3. Listing + navigation layer — AMAZING, not basic (first-class track)

Bar: if a listing looks like a default file browser or a generic card grid, it
FAILS the embarrassment test. Browsing the library must feel like exploring a
living Torah universe. Same intensity as the reader track.

- SERIES LISTING (rich discovery): real cards with DB-backed titles;
  descriptions ONLY where the data has them (ikar has none — elegant quiet,
  never invented text); content counts; recently-updated signals; progress
  where data exists; featured paths. No bland grids of identical boxes.
- SUB-SERIES NAVIGATION: clear hierarchy parent → sub-series → posts;
  breadcrumbs at every depth; contextual movement between levels (siblings,
  up, across); deep nesting stays navigable AND beautiful on mobile (390/430).
- POST LISTINGS within a series: meaningful ordering; metadata hierarchy
  (title → excerpt IF the data has it → length/reading time IF computable →
  recency); continue-reading and recently-visited signals where state exists.
- SEARCH/FILTER at listing level wherever the corpus makes it useful.
- EVERY LEVEL ships truthful loading / empty / error states, plus the shared
  motion language: staggered card entrances, tactile press, route continuity.
- Never fabricate data to fill cards. Truthful elegant empty states where data
  is absent — that IS the luxury.

## 4. File plan (source law)

- Read before writing; rewrite complete files; tabs; no minify; ~120-line
  modules; read-after-write; preserve public contracts or trace every consumer.
- Boot trio, Heichel root renderer, series/sub-series/post listing renderers,
  breadcrumb component, search/filter module — each its own module.

## 5. Verification (see 07 for the full matrix)

- Embarrassment walk on every Heichel route + the metaphor test.
- Takeover tests run continuously by every worker.
- One-tap Home from every Heichel route (gating).
- 390/430 widths for nested navigation; reduced-motion counterparts for every
  entrance/transition.
